activation_condition.licence_gate: the licence of any model named below must be re-confirmed on its model card before adoption — the harvest's lesson from the Sarashina NonCommercial trap is that model selection is gated on the licence column, not the leaderboard column
activation_condition.measure: count of wiki/ pages whose body is predominantly Japanese script (hiragana/katakana/kanji), measured by a corpus scan at activation time
activation_condition.signal: substantial Japanese material in the corpus

evaluation.rule: a track is adopted only on a measured JMTEB-style dual-track comparison over the corpus's own Japanese pages; both tracks are reported, never a merged number alone

pattern: The Japanese retrieval recipe from the round-2 regional harvest: Ruri-v3-class small bi-encoder retrieval with a cross-encoder reranker and exact query/document prefix discipline, evaluated on JMTEB — held as a DORMANT configuration until the corpus carries substantial Japanese material. No embeddings are wired by this file; it states the plan and its activation condition only.

tracks.name: Native Japanese track
stages: embed the query and the Japanese pages with a Ruri-v3-class bi-encoder, applying the model's trained query/document prefixes exactly
retrieve the top candidates by embedding similarity, unioned with the existing BM25/hybrid lanes
rerank the union with a Ruri-v3-class cross-encoder reranker

tracks.name: Translated track
stages: translate the query into English (model slot; unwired while dormant)
retrieve over the existing English BM25/hybrid lanes
merge with the native track by reciprocal rank fusion and report both tracks' hits separately before merging
